name: Mississippi River (Brainerd)

gaugeContext.note: Brainerd station provides upstream same-river context near the regulated Brainerd/Potlatch reach. These trips start downstream, and tributaries can change local flow; this reading is not a calibrated trip-speed model.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS Water Data — Mississippi River at Brainerd, MN

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed model. Published Headwaters Board paddling times are shown only for the matching trips and are not adjusted by live flow.

blurb: Explore the Mississippi below Brainerd with carry-in trips between Kiwanis Park, Riverview Park and Crow Wing State Park. Choose a shorter outing or the full Headwaters Board day trip. The downstream state-park carry-in is separate from its upstream trailer ramp.

sections.difficulty: Moving water; wind, snags and shallows possible
sections.notes: A shorter outing from Brainerd to the public carry-in at Riverview Park in Baxter. Both ends require carrying a small boat. Identify the park approach while arranging your vehicle shuttle.
sections.routeReview: Approximate DNR river-course overview. Exact landing connections, current obstructions and alternate channels are not mapped; published planning mileage stays separate.

Exact shoreline connections and trip speed are independent. Kiwanis is mile 1001.2 in this map and 1001.1 in the GIS inventory.

putInAccess.sourceName: City of Brainerd — 2026 Kiwanis Park map
putInAccess.note: The agency point lies beside the wooded shoreline; the exact carry-in edge is not resolved. The city 2026 park map confirms the canoe launch. DNR route-table mile 1001.2 differs from inventory 1001.1.
putInAccess.directions: Use the public canoe launch at Kiwanis Park, 1101 East River Road in Brainerd. The city map places the launch on the Mississippi side of the park, separate from the Boom Lake fishing pier. Check the carry approach during your shuttle.

takeOutAccess.note: The agency coordinate is beside a wooded approach at the bank. The exact shoreline landing remains obscured; retain the original coordinate as an approximate access area.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use Riverview Park at the end of Riverwood Road in Baxter, reached from Forestview Drive and Scenic River Drive. The DNR lists 6621 Riverwood Road. Follow the public park carry-in approach; inspect the take-out during your shuttle.

sections.takeOut: Mississippi Crow Wing State Park Carry-in
sections.difficulty: Moving water; wind, snags and shallows possible
sections.notes: Paddle from Baxter past the Highway 371 bridge and continue to the downstream carry-in at Crow Wing State Park. Finish just below the Crow Wing River confluence; do not confuse this take-out with the upstream campground trailer ramp.

takeOut.name: Mississippi Crow Wing State Park Trailer Ramp

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate difference between DNR inventory river miles. The trailer ramp has its own mile 992.3; do not use the park-wide extent or the downstream carry-in at 990.4. takeOutAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Crow Wing State Park map and public water-access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: DNR feature WAS02297 documents a concrete trailer ramp at river mile 992.3. Its original digitized coordinate lies on the wooded approach beside the visible ramp, so retain an approximate area. This is distinct from downstream carry-in WAS00990 at mile 990.4. No precise bank badge or water-edge survey is claimed.
takeOutAccess.directions: Enter Crow Wing State Park at 3124 State Park Road and follow signs to the trailer access near the campground. The park map shows it north of the historic town-site area, separate from the downstream carry-in near the Crow Wing River confluence. Inspect the signed ramp and parking while arranging your shuttle; follow current park permit and access rules.
